question: Which of the following combinations of drugs is commonly used in the maintenance treatment of patients with a kidney transplant?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Tacrolimus -> immunosuppression -> maintenance treatment after kidney transplant -> 95% CHAIN: Mycophenolate mofetil -> inhibits T and B lymphocyte proliferation -> commonly used in kidney transplant maintenance -> 90% CHAIN: Glucocorticoids -> anti-inflammatory effects -> adjunct therapy in kidney transplant maintenance -> 95%
analysis: The commonly used combination of drugs in the maintenance treatment of patients with a kidney transplant typically includes an immunosuppressant, an antimetabolite, and sometimes a glucocorticoid to prevent rejection and minimize side effects.
